steps.executor_prompt: Open marriott.com in the default browser and verify the Marriott Bonvoy branding and domain. If an OTP entry field is already visible or Marriott explicitly says a code was sent, stop successfully. Otherwise enter {user} and {password} on the Marriott sign-in form, dismiss the keyboard, submit, and re-observe; if the populated form remains unchanged, dismiss the keyboard and submit once more. If Confirm Your Identity asks you to choose a contact method, select the email address matching {user} and tap Continue; wording that Marriott will send a code and a visible Continue button mean the request is not complete. Stop only when Marriott explicitly confirms the code was sent or displays the OTP entry field. Close only password-reset or account-recovery notices.

Report success only when Marriott shows authenticated account content or an explicit login-success confirmation.
